sources.title: Devolutions Remote Desktop Manager
sources.claim: Vendor presents centralized remote connection management, credential and PAM integrations and AI assistance in Devolutions Server. AI alone is therefore not a demonstrated differentiator.
limitations: Vendor marketing, not independent testing or customer demand evidence.

sources.title: Royal TS features
sources.claim: Royal TS advertises RDP, VNC, SSH, credential management and task automation; the page displays EUR 49 single-user licensing.
limitations: Pricing is version-specific; a newer licensing announcement exists. Do not treat EUR 49 as a verified current checkout quote.

sources.title: Royal Apps licensing and versioning
sources.claim: A separate licensing announcement describes pricing changes for version 26.x; competitor price comparison requires matching versions and maintenance scope.
limitations: No final quote verified in this review.
